Fully decked out with huge TVs, multiple Xbox consoles, bean bags, and more - it's their new favorite hangout.LEARN MORE Welcome to Prairie View Golf Club Prairie View Golf Club is the only Robert Trent Jones, Jr. golf course in Indiana! A layout built to challenge every club in your bag while welcoming golfers of all skill levels. But it's more than great golf, it's a destination for friends and families alike. Since coming under new ownership in February 2025, Prairie View has undergone an extensive transformation. Including a fully renovated Restaurant, a brand new Kids Zone, and an upgraded, fully lighted Driving Range. Enjoy house-smoked BBQ, pizzas baked in an Italian designed pizza oven, nationally loved ice creams, and attentive service from the clubhouse to the 18th hole.
